RITES Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Assistant Manager, Senior Manager Posts - Complete Details

The Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 05 Assistant Manager, Senior Manager. Candidates with B.Tech/B.E, M.E/M.Tech Can Apply Online. The online application opens on 16-09-2026, and closes on 08-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through RITES website, rites.com.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Start Date : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 08.10.2026
  • Written Test (Tentative Date) : 25.10.2026 (same date & time for all posts)
  • Last Date for Online Application & Fee Payment : 08.10.2026
  • Cut-off Date for Age, Experience & Eligibility : 08.10.2026 (last date of application)
  • General / OBC candidates : ₹600 plus applicable taxes
  • EWS / SC / ST / PwBD candidates : ₹300 plus applicable taxes

Application Fee

  • Posts : Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways), Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways), Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling)
  • Application Fee : ₹600 + taxes (General/OBC); ₹300 + taxes (EWS/SC/ST/PwBD, refundable on participation)
  • Online Application Start Date : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 08.10.2026
  • Written Test (Tentative Date) : 25.10.2026 (same date & time for all posts)
  • Commencement of Online Application & Fee Payment : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date for Online Application & Fee Payment : 08.10.2026
  • Written Test (Tentative) : 25.10.2026
  • VC No. / Post : Minimum Qualification
  • RG/27-R1/25 Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) : Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering AND Master's Degree in Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures or Engineering / Structural Engineering or equivalent/synonymous/similar qualification
  • RG/28-R1/25 Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) : Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering AND Master's Degree in Coastal Engineering / Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures or Engineering or equivalent/synonymous/similar qualification
  • Post : Upper Age Limit
  • Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) : 32 years
  • Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) : 32 years
  • SC/ST : 5 years
  • OBC-NCL : 3 years
  • Post : Pay Scale
  • Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) : ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000
  • Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) : ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000
  • General / OBC candidates : ₹600 plus applicable taxes
  • EWS / SC / ST / PwBD candidates : ₹300 plus applicable taxes

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
